mission: Automate Index Generation + Fix All Index Mismatches

index_generator.description: Universal index generator that scans all 6 subsystem directories, generates three-tier indexes (index.json, INDEX_COMPACT.json, SUMMARY.json), detects orphaned files and dangling refs, and outputs a validation report. Idempotent.
features: Scans KB, SCR, SOP, SRC, DATA, TEAM subsystems
Follows SOP-030 universal schema: {version, last_updated, count, entries}
Follows SOP-036 three-tier system (SUMMARY < 500B, COMPACT < 50 tokens/entry)
Universal entry fields: id, title, file, date, team, tags, status
Detects orphaned files (on disk but not indexed)
Detects dangling references (indexed but not on disk)
Auto-assigns IDs for new files discovered on disk
Idempotent: consecutive runs produce identical output

sources_index_fixed.fix_description: All 41 entries now reference actual filenames with descriptive suffixes (e.g., SRC-0001-openalex.json instead of bare SRC-0001.json). Zero dangling refs, zero orphans.

scripts_index_fixed.fix_description: Removed 5 dangling ../coordination/ references. Added 4 formerly orphaned scripts (test-cross-references.py, dedup_utils.py, test_utilities.py, benchmark_runner.py in data-gathering/methods). All 70 entries verified to exist on disk. Zero bad relative paths.

sources_filename_mismatch.before: Index referenced bare IDs (SRC-0001.json) while disk had SRC-0001-openalex.json
sources_filename_mismatch.after: All 41 entries match actual filenames with descriptive suffixes

scripts_dangling_refs.before: 5 entries referenced ../coordination/ paths outside the scripts directory
scripts_dangling_refs.after: Removed; coordination scripts belong to coordination subsystem

scripts_orphaned_files.before: 4 script files on disk had no index entry
scripts_orphaned_files.after: All 4 assigned IDs (SCR-0070 through SCR-0075) and indexed

schema_inconsistency.before: 6 different schemas across subsystem indexes (different key names for entries array, count field, date field, etc.)
schema_inconsistency.after: All indexes use SOP-030 universal schema: {version, last_updated, count, entries[{id, title, file, date, team, tags, status, ...}]}

three_tier_drift.before: SUMMARY, INDEX_COMPACT, and index.json had different counts and out-of-sync entries
three_tier_drift.after: All tiers generated from same source scan; counts match exactly

sop_duplicate_ids.before: SOP-012 and SOP-016 each had v1 and v2 files sharing the same ID
sop_duplicate_ids.after: v2 files now use SOP-012-v2 and SOP-016-v2 as distinct IDs

sop_compliance.SOP-030: Compliant. Universal schema with version, last_updated, count, entries. Universal entry fields: id, title, file, date, team, tags, status.
sop_compliance.SOP-036: Compliant. Three-tier system: SUMMARY.json < 500 bytes, INDEX_COMPACT.json < 50 tokens/entry, index.json full metadata.
sop_compliance.SOP-029: Compliant. All IDs follow PREFIX-NNNN naming (KB-0001, SCR-0068, SOP-030, SRC-0044, DATA-0006, TEAM-0034).
